column2:
[title26][sentence]
This looks like a security station.  There are
a couple monitors on a desk with some
controls on them.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
看起來像是保全站。桌上有
幾台螢幕，上面還有一些
控制裝置。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
This is the security station.  It was
from here that you turned
off all the force fields.
column3: [title29][sentence]\n這是保全站。你就是在這裡\n把所有力場全部關掉的。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You give the grate a couple kicks
and nothing happens.  You work up
a bit of adrenaline and try again.  This
time you hear a loud snap as the latch
gives way.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你朝柵欄踹了幾腳，毫無
反應。你鼓起腎上腺素再試
一次，這回聽到「喀」一聲，
門閂應聲斷裂。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
You trashed the latch when
you first kicked this grate open,
so now all it needs is a gentle
little push . . . .
column3:
[title30][sentence]
你第一次踹開這柵欄時就把
門閂弄壞了，現在只要輕輕
一推就行……

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Other than an expired insurance card
and a couple of wadded up tissues,
there doesn't seem to be anything of
interest in the glove compartment.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
除了一張過期保險卡和幾團
揉皺的衛生紙，置物箱裡
似乎沒什麼有意思的東西。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You recognize the controls here as
the type manufacturers are legally
required to install, even though the
vehicle is fully automated.  They
look like they would be barely 
adequate in the event the automatic
system failed.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你認得這些控制裝置，是
法規規定廠商必須安裝的
那種，即使車子全自動也
得裝。萬一自動系統故障，
這些裝置看起來也只是
聊勝於無。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
What a mess.  Whoever owned this car
was a serious slob.  Apart from the ubiquitous
stuffed cat on the windshield, there is a pile of
soda cans on the floor and a layer of grime on all the
controls.  The central control screen has a thick
layer of dust on it.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
真是一團亂。這車的主人
肯定是個邋遢鬼。除了擋風
玻璃上那隻到處可見的絨毛
貓，地上還堆了一堆汽水
罐，所有控制裝置都蒙上一層
污垢。中控螢幕上更積了
厚厚一層灰。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nThis deodorizer ran out of 'pleasant-smelling\nevergreen disinfectant' about a hundred years ago.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這罐芳香劑的「清新常青
消毒香」大概一百年前就
用完了。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Before you say anything nasty about the
person who left these here, think about
the conditions inside of your refrigerator.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
在你嫌棄留下這些東西的人
之前，先想想自己冰箱裡的
慘況吧。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nHA! Got one!  Oh.  Wait.  It's only\nsuction cupped there.  Drat!
column3:
[title20][sentence]
哈！抓到一個了！喔，等
等，原來只是吸盤黏在那裡。
可惡！

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThrough the amber windshield you can\nsee part of the city, and all of a stuffed cat.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
透過琥珀色擋風玻璃，你能
看見部分城市景色，還有那
隻絨毛貓的全貌。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
Since there is no rear windshield on this
car you assume this must actually be
a video display.  The rear-view camera
appears to be dead.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這車沒有後擋風玻璃，你猜
這其實是一塊顯示螢幕。
後方攝影機似乎已經壞了。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIt's mounted too well to be plucked off.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n裝得太牢了，拔不下來。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIt is disgusting and smelly.  In a way\nit makes you feel right at home.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n又噁心又臭。某種程度上，\n讓你有種賓至如歸的感覺。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
No.  Believe it or not this actually
smells worse than your own.  You would
do better just to keep yours until you
find some clean socks to change into.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
不行。信不信由你，這東西
比你自己的還臭。你還是
先留著自己的，等找到乾淨
襪子再換吧。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You fiddle with the car controls, but
nothing seems to work.  Apparently, that
little scanner doesn't like what it sees.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你擺弄了一下車上的控制
裝置，但什麼都沒反應。
看樣子那小小的掃描器不
喜歡它看到的東西。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nThe scanner consists of a large square plate\nwith a hand-shaped depression in it.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n這台掃描器是一塊大方板，\n上面有個手掌形狀的凹槽。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The monitor is no longer operational.  It
appears that a kidney struck the front of the
picture tube with enough impact energy
to completely destroy the monitor.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這台螢幕已經報銷了。看樣子
有顆腎臟以夠強的衝擊力，
狠狠砸中映像管正面，把
螢幕徹底砸壞了。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The monitor is no longer operational.  It
appears that a rock struck the front of the
picture tube with enough impact energy
to completely destroy the monitor.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這台螢幕已經報銷了。看樣子
有塊石頭以夠強的衝擊力，
狠狠砸中映像管正面，把
螢幕徹底砸壞了。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nThis display's information is probably\nuseful to someone.  But not to you.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n這面板上的資訊大概對某些\n人有用，但對你沒用。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
Whoever modeled for this statue was
obviously a beautiful woman.  You decide
to consider a career in sculpting if you
ever get off this planet.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
幫這座雕像當模特兒的顯然
是個大美女。你心想，要是
能離開這顆星球，不如考慮
改行當雕刻家。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This must have belonged to that dead
guard over there.  You find it odd that
there is no tape in it.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這東西一定是那邊那個死
守衛的。你覺得奇怪，裡面
居然沒有錄音帶。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nIt's wrecked--like most things in this room.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n壞了——跟這房間裡大多數\n東西一樣。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Yech!  An amputated arm lies on the
floor.  The hand is empty, and the elbow
is bent slightly.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
噁！地上躺著一隻斷手臂。
手掌空空如也，手肘微微
彎曲。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou ponder the possible uses of such a device.\nAfter a moment you give up.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n你思考這裝置到底有什麼\n用途。想了半天，還是放棄了。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIt's about time for you to find\nthat vase and get off this planet.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n你也該去找那個花瓶，然後\n離開這顆星球了。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nYou haven't a clue what this gauge\nmeasures.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n你完全搞不懂這個儀表在\n量什麼。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThis where that guard put all your stuff\nwhen you were captured.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n這就是你被抓時，那個守衛\n收走你所有東西的地方。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Good news!  Most of your belongings are
still here.  What's missing has probably
been taken away for analysis.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
好消息！你的大部分家當
都還在這裡。少掉的東西，
八成是被拿去化驗了。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Wouldn't you know it: nothing but worthless
junk.  It looks like they are long overdue for
garage sale.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你就知道：全是些不值錢的
破爛。看來早該辦場車庫
拍賣了。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You remember begin led down
this hall when you were captured.
The hall is now in pretty sad shape.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你記得被抓的時候曾被押著
走過這條走廊。現在這裡
慘不忍睹。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This is the security room where you
had that stimulating pat down.  Since 
then things have changed for the worse.
Most of the equipment is destroyed and
there is a dead guard lying on the floor.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這是保全室，你曾在這裡
接受那次「刺激」的搜身。
此後情況每況愈下。大部分
設備都毀了，地上還躺著
一具守衛的屍體。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nYou don't need any of these things.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n這些東西你一樣都用不著。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nGood idea.  You never know when you'll\nget the urge to crank up some tunes.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n好主意。誰知道你什麼時候\n會突然想聽點音樂呢。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You carefully pick up the amputated
arm.  You decide to carry it around
for as short a period of time as possible.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n你小心翼翼撿起那隻斷手臂，\n決定盡量縮短帶著它的時間。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The desk is broken in about a thousand
places.  The extent of the damage in
this room amazes you.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這張桌子大概斷成一千塊了。
這房間的破壞程度讓你
嘆為觀止。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
Look at that!  It's the same woman who
patted you down and took away all
your stuff.  It doesn't look like she's 
going to be giving you any more pat-downs
now.  Too bad.  She appears to be missing
an arm and one or more internal organs.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你看！就是那個搜你身、
沒收你東西的女人。看樣子
她是沒辦法再搜你身了。
真可惜。她似乎少了一隻
手臂，還有一兩個內臟。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
There is another room through this
doorway.  It looks like it has had the
same kind of rough day this room has
had.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這道門後還有一個房間。
看來它跟這間一樣，都經歷
了慘烈的一天。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nThe table has been splintered.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n這張桌子碎成木片了。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The projector has been damaged
beyond repair.  Your friend didn't
miss much coming through here.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這台投影機壞得無法修了。
你那位朋友經過這裡時，
可沒放過什麼東西。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
It's a good thing your massive friend
didn't take this support out.  The whole
room probably would have caved in.
At least he showed some restraint.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
幸好你那位大塊頭朋友沒把
這根支柱拆掉，不然整間
房間大概都會塌下來。至少
他還算有點分寸。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nIt's completely destroyed.\n
column3: [title16][sentence]\n完全毀了。\n

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The view screen is to be divided into
three main regions.  The first describes
your currently selected destination; the
second shows you a schematic map of
the city; and the third relays some system
status information in characters that are
meaningless to you.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這面螢幕分成三個主要區塊：
第一區顯示你目前選定的
目的地；第二區是城市的
示意地圖；第三區則顯示一些
系統狀態資訊，只是那些
文字對你來說毫無意義。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The control panel consists of a view screen,
some kind of indicator (which appears broken),
and some buttons.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這面控制板包含一個螢幕、
一個指示器（看起來壞了），
還有幾個按鈕。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The street continues deep into the heart of the
city.  You can't help but notice what has got to
be the gaudiest condominium you have ever seen.
A large sign announces the residence of someone
who must have a serious neon fetish.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這條街一路通向市中心。你
忍不住注意到眼前這棟，大概
是你見過最俗艷的公寓。一塊
大招牌宣告這裡住著一個
對霓虹燈有嚴重癖好的人。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The street continues deep into the heart of the
city.  You can't help but notice what has got to
be the gaudiest condominium you have ever seen.
A large sign announces the residence of someone
who must have a serious neon fetish.  You notice
a pencil thin beam of light protruding from the
roof.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這條街一路通向市中心。你
忍不住注意到眼前這棟，大概
是你見過最俗艷的公寓。一塊
大招牌宣告這裡住著一個
對霓虹燈有嚴重癖好的人。
你還注意到屋頂伸出一道
鉛筆細的光束。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This is the car you arrived in.  It has
not changed significantly since you
left it.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這就是你搭來的那輛車。
自從你離開後，它沒什麼
變化。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The large coliseum in the distance
occupies several city blocks.  It is
almost as big as the sports arena you
frequent on Umbilica IV.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
遠處那座巨大競技場佔了好
幾個街區，大小幾乎媲美你
常去的臍帶星四號體育館。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nThe buildings here do not interest you.
column3: [title24][sentence]\n這裡的建築物引不起你的\n興趣。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
Exploring this entire city on
foot would be a bad plan.  You
decide to stay close to the car.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
徒步逛遍整座城市可不是
什麼好主意。你決定待在車
附近。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
The balcony protrudes from the tackiest
condo in the history of modern architecture.
The white pillars make you wish you
had a chainsaw.  Francois would love
this place.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
這座陽台，從現代建築史上
最俗氣的公寓伸出來。那些
白柱子讓你很想找台電鋸。
法蘭索瓦一定會愛死這裡。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nThe entrance is wide open.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n入口大大敞開著。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The vast cylindrical perimeter wall
stretches hundreds of feet over
your head.  At the top, you can see
a circle of bright blue sky.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
巨大的圓柱形外牆，在你
頭頂上延伸數百呎高。牆頂
可以看見一圈明亮的藍天。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThe city stretches off into the distance.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n城市向遠方延伸而去。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
As you stare at the statue, your
bladder begins to feel distinctly
smaller and tighter.  You quickly
force yourself to look away before
a horrible accident happens.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
你盯著這座雕像看，膀胱
突然覺得又小又緊。你趕緊
強迫自己移開視線，免得
發生什麼糗事。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The walls here look like they are
coated with something.  It's
probably some sort of sound
isolation.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n這裡的牆壁看起來塗了些\n什麼，大概是某種隔音材料。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
After being hit by that guard you
got to know the floor pretty well.
It doesn't hold your attention any
longer now than it did then.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
被那個守衛揍過之後，你跟
這片地板已經很熟了。現在
看它，也不比當初更有
興趣。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThis corridor leads back to the cell block.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n這條走廊通回牢房區。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThere is a strange device part way down\nthis corridor.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n走廊中段有個奇怪的裝置。

column2:
[title28][sentence]
Judging by the size of the faucet there
must be a great deal of  cleaning up
to do around here.  You wonder what
sort of activity would require such
frequent large-scale cleaning.
column3:
[title28][sentence]
看這水龍頭的尺寸，這裡
一定常常要大清洗。你很
好奇，到底是什麼活動需要
這麼頻繁的大規模清潔。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nThis looks like a normal sink.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n看起來是個普通的水槽。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThis must be where they put the\nless cooperative 'guests'.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n這裡大概是關那些「不太\n合作的貴賓」的地方。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThis large, sharp, intimidating blade\nsends a shiver down your spine.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n這把碩大鋒利、殺氣騰騰\n的刀刃，讓你不寒而慄。

column2: [title13][sentence]\nThe monitor is not on.
column3: [title13][sentence]\n螢幕沒開。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
These are the strangest cabinets you
have ever seen.  They look more like
filing slots for loose limbs.  Your curiosity
regarding their contents quickly subsides.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這是你見過最詭異的櫃子，
看起來更像是放散落肢體
的檔案格。你對裡面裝什麼
的好奇心，瞬間就消退了。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The equipment here is not unlike the
equipment in the rest of this complex.
Its purpose is completely beyond you.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這裡的設備跟這棟建築其他
地方的差不多，用途完全
讓你摸不著頭緒。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThere are a few small red stains on the\nshelf.  It is otherwise uninteresting.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n架子上有幾個小紅斑點，\n除此之外沒什麼看頭。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nFor the moment, this is home.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n目前，這裡就是你家。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You are all too familiar with this
gurney.  You have no urge to lie
on it ever again.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n你對這張推床太熟悉了，\n完全不想再躺上去。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This must be where the attending 'physician'
keeps medical instruments.  The only items
of note on it are a corkscrew, a feather, and
a scalpel.  These do not look like 'friendly'
instruments.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這裡大概是那位「主治醫師」
擺放醫療器械的地方。上面
值得一提的只有開瓶器、
羽毛，還有一把手術刀。
這些看起來都不像什麼
「善意」的器具。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This is the small table you stole
the scalpel from.  There are not
any instruments on it just now.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這就是你偷走手術刀的那張
小桌子。現在上面已經沒有
任何器械了。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This must be some sort of examination room.
From your 'secure' position you see a large
saw blade, a pretty intern, and the ceiling.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這裡大概是某種診察室。
從你「安穩」的姿勢望去，
只看得到一片大鋸片、一位
漂亮的實習醫生，還有天花板。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
This is the medical examination room.
That pretty girl has left.  She must have finished
whatever she was doing with the instruments on the
table.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這是醫療診察室。那位漂亮
女孩已經離開了。她大概是
把桌上那些器械要做的事
做完了。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nThis is the medical examination room.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n這是醫療診察室。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Sorry, they are locked and there
is no obvious locking mechanism
or insertion point for a key.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
抱歉，它們是鎖著的，而且
看不出明顯的鎖具或插鑰匙
的地方。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThis pretty young woman is tinkering\nwith something on the instrument table.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n這位漂亮的年輕女子正在\n器械桌上擺弄著什麼東西。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The door is locked, barred, and probably
welded closed.  This is one woman you
won't be snooping on.  Besides, what if
she were actually in there?
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這扇門上了鎖、加了閂，
大概還被焊死了。這位女士
你是別想偷窺了。再說，
萬一她真的在裡面呢？

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This woman is definitely 'well done'.  This
must be the professor the intern went to check
on after that explosion.  She has a tape recorder
in her hand.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這位女士絕對是「烤得很
透」了。她應該就是實習
醫生在爆炸後跑去探望的
那位教授。她手裡還握著一台
錄音機。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
She appears to have quite a grip on
the tape recorder. There is an audio
tape inside it.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n她似乎緊緊抓著那台錄音機\n不放。裡面還有一捲錄音帶。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This is the tape recorder you got
that little audio tape from.  She still
has a death-grip on it.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這就是你拿到那捲小錄音帶
的錄音機。她還是死抓著
不放。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You can't get the tape recorder loose from
her fingers.  She has a death-grip on it that
you just can't break.  You do manage to
open it and take out a small cassette.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你沒辦法從她指縫間扳開
錄音機，她死抓著不放，
你怎麼掰都掰不開。不過你
倒是設法打開機身，取出了
一捲小卡帶。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThe professor's gurney is currently\nholding the charred professor off the floor.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
教授的推床，目前正撐著
這位焦黑的教授，讓她不至於
躺在地上。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
Quickly, while the intern is out of
the room, you reach out and grab the
scalpel.  You squirrel it away in your
sleeve and hope that no one will notice
its absence.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
趁實習醫生不在房間裡，
你迅速伸手抓起那把手術刀，
偷偷藏進袖子裡，希望沒人
會發現它不見了。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You look up the elevator shaft.  You
can see that it does not stop at the upper
level of the city, but in fact runs all the
way up to the rim of the cylinder which the
city was built in.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你抬頭望向電梯井，發現
它不是只通到城市的上層，
而是一路通到整座城市所在
圓柱體的邊緣。

column2: [title29][sentence]\nThe elevator door is closed.  There is,\nhowever, a card slot adjacent to the left door.
column3: [title29][sentence]\n電梯門是關著的。不過左側\n門旁有個插卡槽。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIt appears that the elevator doesn't\nwork without some sort of access card.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n看樣子沒有某種通行卡，\n電梯就無法運作。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
This culture must have taken their
designated handicapped parking spaces
seriously.  In fine print, at the bottom of
the sign, you read: "Violators will be given
good reason to park here."
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這個文化顯然很重視身障
專用停車格。告示牌底部的
小字寫著：「違規停車者，
將有充分理由停在這裡。」

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This looks like a hitching post for
horses.  The presence of such a device
strikes you as out of place in a city
which uses MLV's for transportation.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這看起來像是拴馬樁。在
一座用磁浮車代步的城市裡，
出現這種東西讓你覺得格格
不入。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Now THAT is a big mall.  There is
no end in sight.  There is no entrance
in sight, for that matter.  The mere thought
of entering a mall sends shivers down
your spine.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這才叫大型購物中心。看不
到盡頭，說真的，連入口
都看不到。光是想到要走
進購物中心，就讓你不寒而
慄。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Someone was running a special on
internal organs.  You wonder if they
were being sold as replacements, or as
stew meat.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
有人在特價賣內臟。你不
知道那是要拿去當替換器官，
還是燉湯用的肉。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The street stretches off into the bowels
of the city.  You decide that it would be
best if you stayed close to the car.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這條街一路通向城市的
深處。你覺得還是待在車
附近比較妥當。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The street ends here.  You are at the edge
of the cylinder in which the city is built.
You are between a mall and an elevator.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這條街到這裡就到底了。
你正站在城市所在圓柱體的
邊緣，夾在購物中心和電梯
之間。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIt's a safe bet that card slot adjacent to the left\ndoor operates the elevator.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n十之八九，左側門旁那個\n插卡槽就是用來啟動電梯的。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
It won't fit.  Don't forget where you got
that security card.  It is no great surprise
that it's useless in this city.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
插不進去。別忘了那張保全
卡是哪來的，在這座城市裡
派不上用場也不奇怪。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nIt hasn't changed while parked here.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n停在這裡之後，它沒什麼\n變化。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The brick continues up to the next level,
then gives way to sheet metal.  You pause
again to marvel at the size of the cylinder
in which this enormous city is built.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
磚牆一路延伸到上一層，
再往上就換成鐵皮。你再次
停下腳步，驚嘆這座巨城所在
圓柱體的規模。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The monitoring equipment looks like it
must have been used to keep tabs on
various automatic functions of the city.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這套監控設備看起來是用
來監看城市各種自動化功能
的。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You are quite familiar with the Lemington OK-4
photon rifle.  It fires a coherent stream of
photons at the target, burning it to a crisp.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你對雷明頓 OK-4 光子步槍
相當熟悉。它會朝目標發射
一道相干光子束，把對方燒得
焦黑酥脆。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nNot a chance.  The display case is impenetrable.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n想都別想。這展示櫃堅不\n可摧。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The lovely display case holds a few
interesting weapons.  Unfortunately the
case is made of a material that is
truly Rex-proof.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這座漂亮的展示櫃裡擺著
幾件有趣的武器。可惜櫃子
的材質是貨真價實的「雷克斯
剋星」。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
Cool!  You saw one of these on display
at a future weapons conference.  The
exhibition was phenomenal.  Ever since
then, you've always wanted to carry one
around in your back pocket.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
酷！你曾在一場未來武器
展上看過這玩意兒展出，
那場展覽精彩絕倫。從那時
起，你就一直想在後口袋
裡揣一把。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You are a bit thirsty, but the water
looks stagnant.  The bottle probably
hasn't been changed in at least a
hundred years.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你有點口渴，但這水看起來
死氣沉沉。這瓶水大概至少
一百年沒換過了。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This large wooden box does not appear
to have any openings.  You would think
the top would lift off, but can't get it to
budge.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這個大木箱看起來沒有任何
開口。你以為蓋子能掀開，
但怎麼弄都紋風不動。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nYou grunt and groan but accomplish nothing.\nThere must be some trick to it.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n你又哼又喊，卻毫無進展。\n這裡頭一定有什麼訣竅。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You get an eerie feeling that maybe you 
shouldn't be here.  It's the same feeling
you had right before you were blown out
of the sky.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你有種毛骨悚然的預感，
覺得自己不該出現在這裡。
跟你被轟出天際前的感覺
一模一樣。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You assume that this is where the booking process
takes place.  Reading you your rights, thumb
printing, taking mug shots . . . YOU know the routine.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你猜這裡就是辦理登記
的地方。宣讀權利、按
指紋、拍大頭照……你懂
這套流程。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The monitor displays pertinent
information on suspects, such as hair
color, height, weight, social diseases, etc.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這台螢幕顯示嫌犯的相關
資料，像是髮色、身高、
體重、性病史等等。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThis is an odd place for a filing cabinet.\nThey must have been moving it.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n檔案櫃放在這裡真奇怪。\n他們大概正在搬動它。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThe cabinets are empty.  They must have been\nmoving this just before they all went . . . where?
column3:
[title26][sentence]
櫃子是空的。他們一定是在
全部離開之前，正搬到一半
就……去哪了？

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The box contains a pair of odd-looking
objects that resemble detonators
for explosives.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
箱子裡裝著一對造型古怪的
東西，看起來像是炸藥用的
雷管。

column2: [title13][sentence]\nThe box is now empty.
column3: [title13][sentence]\n箱子現在空了。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nIt looks like someone left behind\na couple of detonators.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n看樣子有人留下了幾個\n雷管。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You carefully pick up the detonators
and put them gingerly in your pocket, 
making a mental note not to do any
jumping jacks for a while.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你小心翼翼撿起雷管，輕輕
放進口袋，並在心裡告訴
自己，這陣子最好別做開合
跳。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nYou see the edge of the city, and the\nsky above.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n你看見城市的邊緣，還有\n上方的天空。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The display case to the right contains
several interesting weapons.  There is
a guard station on the left, complete
with all manners of law enforcement
equipment.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
右邊的展示櫃裡放著幾件
有趣的武器。左邊則是警衛
站，配備各種執法裝備一應
俱全。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou would probably need a nuclear bomb \nto get this impenetrable case opened.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n想打開這個堅不可摧的櫃子，\n大概得動用核彈。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
It would most likely bounce off and possibly
bean you in the head.  Save your strength.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
那東西多半會彈回來，
說不定還會砸中你的頭。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
A lone man seems the only inhabitant of
this grungy alley.  Several pairs of red
eyes watch you from dark hiding places.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這條髒亂的小巷裡，似乎
只住著一個孤零零的男人。
幾雙紅眼睛從陰暗的角落
盯著你看。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Since Herman has gone to his place in the woods,
only a few small rodents remain to scurry about
in the alley.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
自從賀曼去了他林子裡的
住處後，巷子裡就只剩幾隻
小型鼠類到處竄。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The man in the alley seems extremely nervous
in your presence.  He looks as though he hasn't
taken a bath in a year or two.  You don't know
what the native life span is, but he looks ancient.
He is wearing some kind of personal stereo.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
巷子裡這個男人，一看到你
就顯得極度緊張。他看起來
大概一兩年沒洗澡了。你不
知道這裡的人平均壽命多長，
但他看起來老態龍鍾。他身上
還戴著某種隨身音響。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nAll sorts of trash has been dumped here.\nThis looks like your bedroom on the Pig.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這裡堆滿了各式各樣的垃圾，
看起來就像你在油豬號上的
臥室。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nYou have absolutely no use for two thousand\npounds of miscellaneous trash.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n兩千磅的雜七雜八垃圾，\n你一點用處都沒有。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThis could hold a large appliance for shipping\nor a mid-sized person for sleeping.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這東西可以裝下一台大型
家電來運送，或是讓一個
中等身材的人躺著睡覺。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nWhat are you going to do with that?\nTake it home and play in it?
column3: [title22][sentence]\n你打算拿那個做什麼？\n扛回家當玩具玩嗎？

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIt has already been opened wide enough for you to realize\nthat it is empty.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n它已經開得夠大了，你一眼\n就看得出裡面是空的。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
The refrigerator looks older that the
hermit.  Rust has replaced the enamel
finish in most places.  The hinges also
appear to be badly rusted.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這台冰箱看起來比那位隱士
還老。搪瓷早已被鐵鏽取代，
幾乎整台都是。鉸鍊看起來
也鏽得很嚴重。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nNot likely.  Those hinges might as\nwell be welded solid.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n別妄想了。那些鉸鍊簡直\n跟焊死沒兩樣。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The last thing you need now is a hernia.
You don't normally go around trying
to stuff major appliances into your
pocket.  Why start now?
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你現在最不需要的就是疝氣。
你平常也不會沒事把大型
家電塞進口袋，現在何必
破例？

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The large buildings surrounding the
alley are weather worn and covered
with graffiti.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n巷子四周的大樓，一個個\n風吹雨打、滿是塗鴉。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
For the most part, the graffiti on the wall
is no different from that which can be
found in any city on any world.  However,
a few random scribblings like "73766,347"
and "PTJT50A" strike you as unusual.
There are several good limericks and a
candid opinion about the questionable
parentage of someone named Bruce.  A
wave of poetic inspiration comes over
you, but after searching your pockets you
realize you forgot to bring your spray paint can.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
牆上的塗鴉大多跟任何星球
任何城市看到的沒兩樣。不過
有幾行亂寫的字，像是
「73766，347」和「PTJT50A」，
讓你覺得有點奇怪。還有幾首
不錯的打油詩，以及對一個叫
布魯斯的傢伙身世的坦白
評論。一股詩興突然湧上心頭，
可惜翻遍口袋才發現，你忘了
帶噴漆罐。
